During a stream, #Diplo appeared to play a UNRELEASED & never heard #XXXTentacion song that had reportedly been sitting in his folders — and fans are already wondering what else could still be hidden away. 😳🔥

With XXXTentacion’s 🕊️ catalog having been revisited and expanded through posthumous releases over the years, there are reportedly only a limited number of known collaborations and unreleased recordings that could potentially ever see the light of day. 

Some artists who worked with X have chosen to keep their unreleased material private, meaning certain songs may remain unheard indefinitely. 💔

If this track just sits in Diplo’s vault, the preview has fans asking one major question: will we ever get the full song?
